scenes.headline:
ChatGPT is now
inside Microsoft Word.
scenes.body: And OpenAI says it is available on all ChatGPT plans — including Free.

scenes.headline:
Not just another
chat window.
scenes.body: ChatGPT opens in a sidebar and can work with the document you already have open.

scenes.headline: What can it do?
scenes.body: Draft from notes. Summarize documents. Rewrite selected text. Adjust headings, structure and formatting.

scenes.headline: The useful part?
scenes.body: Less copy-pasting between Word and ChatGPT. The AI is moving directly into the tool where the work happens.

scenes.headline: Who gets access?
scenes.body: OpenAI says ChatGPT for Word is available on every ChatGPT plan, including Free. Workplace admins can still restrict the add-in.

scenes.headline: How to try it
scenes.body: Install the ChatGPT Microsoft add-in, open Word, sign in, then use ChatGPT from the sidebar.

scenes.headline: AI at work is changing.
scenes.body: Less tab-switching. More AI inside the tools you already use. Follow @buildwith_pankaj for practical AI updates.

captions.text: AI IS MOVING INTO YOUR WORKFLOW
